notes: "I want to start with why this exists, not with a feature list. I make slides constantly — group meeting, lab presentations, talks. Over the last year I became convinced that agents will write slides the way they now write code and text. The question I care about is not whether they can, but whether the result can sound like a person. This is the story of the two or three things that got in the way, and the editor I built around them."
